items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 7:1
items.html: All the levels that came out in the world of Atzilut are called the new MA, or the new light. And this excludes what remained of the lights and vessels of Nekudim, which were corrected to the discernment of the females of the Partzufim of Atzilut. And likewise all the vessels, lights and sparks of ZA that ascend and are sorted from the Klipot — all these are called by the name the old light, or BON. And the discernment of the males of all the Partzufim of Atzilut is from the new MA, that is, through the couplings made anew after the breaking of the vessels, in order to correct and revive the dead. (Item 17).
